summary_1line: Yudhishthira debates peace versus war with Krishna, who offers to seek peace but warns that Kshatriya duty may require battle against Duryodhana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands before Yudhishthira and the Pandavas, promising to go to the Kuru court while warriors listen in tense anticipation.
Two dogs circle each other with bared teeth, tails stiff and barking, moments before a violent fight begins.
Krishna declares that if harmed he will consume all the Kurus, his figure calm yet radiating overwhelming power.
